posts.title: Azaadi Ka Din — Grand Launch
posts.caption:
Kuch kursiyan sirf baithne ke liye nahi hoti. Kuch kursiyan itihaas ki gawah hoti hain.

Habibs ki hairdressing legacy ek daur se shuru hui jab hunar hi pehchaan tha. Founder Habib Ahmed — ek family of elite barbers mein paida hue, London mein trained, aur India mein modern professional salon culture lekar aaye. Unhone Bharat ke kai pramukh vyaktitvon ko style kiya — Indira Gandhi ji se lekar Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam tak.

Teen peedhiyon se ek hi vishwas: hairdressing sirf service nahi, ek craft hai. Aur aaj wahi craft aapke shehar, aapki kursi tak pahuncha hai.

Ab hum Instagram par bhi. Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Vintage barber chair, warm low light, sepia archival textures → match-cut to full-colour modern Habibs floor with present-day stylists on real clients. Leaders as elegant text cards + voiceover only, NO recreated faces. End card: "Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha. — Habibs."
posts.productionNotes: 25–30s. Hybrid — IRL salon + AI heritage atmosphere. 1 senior stylist + 3–4 clients. Guardrails: no flag on chairs/products; Kalam & Indira in VO+text only, no AI faces/look-alikes.

posts.title: Teen Peedhiyan — The Habibs Legacy
posts.caption:
Ek hunar. Teen peedhiyan. Ek hi vishwas — hairdressing sirf service nahi, ek craft hai.

Swipe through the story 👉
→ Founder Habib Ahmed: born 1940, family of elite barbers, London-trained, the man who brought organized salon culture to India.
→ Uske haath ne Bharat ke icons ko style kiya — Indira Gandhi ji & Dr. A. P. J. Abdul Kalam jaise naam.
→ Agli peedhiyon ne is virasat ko aage badhaya — aaj Habibs 100s of salons tak.

Aur aaj yeh legacy aapke shehar tak. Is virasat ka hissa baniye.
Desh badla. Style badla. Hunar wahi raha. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: 8 slides, cream + red/white brand palette, elegant serif. S1 title "The Chair That Witnessed History"; S2–3 heritage textures; S4 founder card; S5 icons named (type card); S6 next-gen team; S7 modern salons; S8 tagline + CTA.
posts.productionNotes: Carousel · IRL stills + design. Design + brand photos, no shoot. Founder photo only if brand-owned. No recreated faces. Keep to salonhabibs.in + documented facts.

posts.title: Meet the Experts Behind the Chair (Stylist Showcase)
posts.caption:
Aapke look ke peeche ek trained haath hota hai — aur Habibs ke stylists yun hi nahi bante.

International training, years of experience, aur teen peedhiyon ki craft legacy — har cut, har colour, har look ke peeche yeh expertise hai. Yeh sirf salon staff nahi, yeh artists hain.

Milne aao apne shehar ke Habibs experts se.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Cinematic team feature. Confident portraits of real stylists at work — mid-cut, mid-colour, focused hands. On-screen name + credential lower-thirds ("Senior Stylist · X yrs · [certification]"). Premium, aspirational, warm light. End card: "The Experts of Habibs" + logo.
posts.productionNotes: 20–25s. IRL. Feature 3–4 real stylists (get their consent + accurate credentials — only state qualifications that are true). Gear: gimbal, key light. This doubles as internal team pride content.

posts.title: Habibs = Sirf Haircut? Nahi.
posts.caption:
"Habibs matlab haircut" — ruk jao. Poori list dekho 👉

Hair · Colour & Highlights · Treatments (keratin, smoothening, hair spa) · Skin & Facials · Threading & Waxing · Nails · Bridal & Groom · Makeup · Complete-Look Packages.

Sab ek hi jagah. Ek appointment. Ek bill.
Do jagah kyun, jab ek kaafi hai?
Save this 🔖 & DM 'POORA' for your nearest outlet. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: 9 slides, bold red/white/cream. S1 myth-bust title; S2–8 one service each (icon + real photo + one-line benefit); S9 "Poora Look. Ek Jagah." + CTA.
posts.productionNotes: Carousel · IRL service stills + design. Design + stills. One clean photo per service from outlet shoots. Build an icon set. One line per slide.

posts.title: We're Finally on Instagram (Social Launch Welcome)
posts.caption:
Salon mein aap humein jaante ho. Ab yahan bhi. 👋

Habibs officially Instagram par hai — aapke looks, tips, transformations aur behind-the-scenes, sab ek jagah.

Aur jashn ke liye — humara pehla Instagram-exclusive treat: [INSERT SOCIAL-EXCLUSIVE PERK — e.g. "screenshot this post & show at your nearest outlet for a complimentary [service/add-on] with any booking"]. Limited period, participating outlets.

Follow karo, aur poora look ke liye taiyaar ho jao.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs *T&C apply.
posts.visualDirection: Clean welcome card. Brand red/white, warm hero image (happy client / salon interior), bold "Now on Instagram" headline, the exclusive perk called out clearly, logo + handle prominent. Premium, uncluttered.
posts.productionNotes: Static Post · Design. NEEDS FROM CLIENT: the actual social-exclusive perk (not a grand-opening discount — brand already exists offline), validity, participating outlets, T&C, redemption method (screenshot/DM code). Franchise sign-off before scheduling.

posts.title: Onam Ashamsakal — Festive Ready
posts.caption:
Iss Onam, tradition ko do ek naya glow. ✨

Kasavu ki elegance, jasmine ka gajra, aur ek soft festive look — Onam ka poora look, ek hi jagah.
Onam Ashamsakal! 🌼 Get festive-ready at Habibs.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Warm, elegant. Woman in authentic kasavu; stylist finishing low bun + real jasmine gajra; dewy makeup. Pookalam + brass nilavilakku in frame, soft natural light, graceful slow-mo. End card: Onam greeting + logo.
posts.productionNotes: 20–25s. Reel · IRL. Shoot a day ahead, post ON the 26th. Authentic kasavu + fresh jasmine, pookalam, nilavilakku. Cultural care — greeting-led, not salesy (esp. South outlets).

posts.title: Is Rakhi, Behen Ko Do Ek Habibs Day
posts.caption:
Bhai, is baar rakhi ka gift chocolate se aage ho. 🎁

Ek Habibs gift card = ek poora pamper day. Hair, facial, nails — behen ka apna glow-up din.
Is Rakhi, behen ko do ek Habibs day. Gift vouchers available — DM 'RAKHI'.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Warm home → salon. Rakhi thali & thread; brother surprises sister with a Habibs gift card; cut to her being pampered — hair wash, facial, nails, big smile. Feel-good, uplifting audio. End: gift-card visual + "Gift vouchers available" + logo.
posts.productionNotes: 20–25s. Reel · IRL. Shoot ahead, post ON the 28th. 2 talent (brother/sister). NEEDS FROM CLIENT: confirm vouchers exist + how to buy (link/DM/outlet).

posts.title: Do Jagah Kyun? — The Habibs Difference
posts.caption:
Ek look ke liye kitni jagah bhagoge?

Ek taraf: teen dukaanein, chaar bill, poora Saturday gone. Doosri taraf: Habibs — hair, skin, nails, brows, sab ek hi sitting mein, ek hi bill.
Do jagah kyun, jab ek kaafi hai?
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs. Book now.
posts.visualDirection: Split-screen. LEFT: hectic, desaturated, running between places, timestamps piling up, messy sound, no music. RIGHT: calm, warm, one Habibs chair, parallel services, single soft track, timer barely moves. Dissolve to one clean frame + line.
posts.productionNotes: 25–30s. Hybrid — IRL + AI stylized transitions. IRL split-screen + AI for stylized transitions/timestamp motion. 1 hero model both sides. Flagship "engine" — reuse for future comparison reels.

posts.title: Why Habibs — The Premium Standard
posts.caption:
Premium sirf ek shabd nahi. Yeh har detail mein dikhta hai.

Swipe 👉
→ Trained, expert stylists — teen peedhiyon ki craft legacy.
→ Professional, branded products.
→ Strict hygiene & sanitized tools.
→ Personalised consultation — aapke chehre, aapke hair ke hisaab se.
→ Same standard, har outlet mein.

Experience the standard. Book at your nearest Habibs.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: 6 slides, premium red/white + cream, lots of whitespace. S1 title; S2–5 one pillar each (experts/products/hygiene/consultation) with real photo + short line; S6 tagline + CTA.
posts.productionNotes: Carousel · IRL outlet stills + design. Design + real outlet photos. Genuine brand products in frame. Truthful claims only — "internationally trained" only where accurate.

posts.title: First Time at Habibs / GRWM (UGC)
posts.caption:
"Pehli baar Habibs try kiya… aur ab main wapas ja rahi hoon."

Real experience, real reaction — walk-in se lekar final look tak. Koi filter nahi, bas honest baat.
Aapka Habibs experience kaisa tha? Tag us with #MyHabibsLook — hum repost karenge.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Raw, phone-shot, vertical, handheld — deliberately unpolished. Customer POV: selfie walk-in, quick service clips, candid mirror reveal, honest talking reaction. Natural sound; trending audio optional. No polished AI.
posts.productionNotes: Reel (UGC) · IRL only — raw. Source via (1) micro-influencer/real regular comped visit filming in their own style, or (2) #MyHabibsLook repost push (with permission). Brand hands-off the edit. Seed the hashtag from Day 1.

posts.title: The Habibs Bride
posts.caption:
Shaadi ka season aa gaya. Aur har dulhan ka ek sapna — apne din pe sabse khoobsurat lagna.

Habibs Bridal Package mein sab shaamil — Pre-Bridal (5 din pehle: waxing, spa mani-pedi, haircut, hair spa, glow facial, skin polishing) se lekar Wedding Day (bridal make-up, hair styling, saree draping) tak. Complete Bride Package ₹24,000+ se (Members ₹20,000+).

Apni bridal trial abhi book karein. DM 'BRIDE'.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Emotional build → reveal. Soft prep shots (mehendi, foils, facial, hair pinning) → dramatic reveal, bride turns to camera in full look. Warm golden light, traditional-modern audio, slow-mo reveal. Optional light AI backdrop/particles on reveal frame only — bride is 100% real footage. End card: package line + logo.
posts.productionNotes: 25–30s. Reel · IRL (optional AI backdrop only). Real outfit/jewellery (boutique barter if possible), MUA + hairstylist + draping. Confirm current prices; keep the "+". Signed model release.

posts.title: Book Your Poora Look
posts.caption:
Ek mahina. Ek waada. Poora look, ek jagah.

Hair, skin, beauty, bridal — sab ek chhat ke neeche. Aapke shehar mein Habibs, aapke liye taiyaar.
Book now — DM, call, ya walk in. Find your nearest Habibs.
Poora Look. Ek Jagah. — Habibs
posts.visualDirection: Clean, confident brand card. Hero image (happy client / elegant complete look) or elegant flat-lay. Red/white/cream. Clear CTA + contact (DM / website / phone). Logo prominent. Consistent with launch look to close the arc.
posts.productionNotes: Static Post · Design. NEEDS FROM CLIENT: booking channels (DM/WhatsApp/phone/website) + confirm "salon near me" locator works. 1 hero image.
